name: Foster's Home for Imaginary Friends
description: What happens when a child outgrows his trusty Imaginary Friend, the pal that stuck with him through all of the highs and lows of growing up? Well, these creations pack up and head for Foster's Home for Imaginary Friends! Foster's is a one-of-a-kind Victorian mansion filled with hundreds of unique characters from all over the world, thought up by completely different children for completely different reasons. These creatures all live together in this vast, sprawling home with more rooms than you could ever dream possible! Mac, a clever but somewhat shy 8-year-old boy, discovers Foster's when his mom tells him he's too old for his Imaginary Friend Blooregard. Not ready to part with his trouble making best buddy, Mac takes Bloo to Foster's with the hope of giving him a safe place to live, while still being able to visit every day.

videos.title: Neighborhood Wash
videos.overview: Mac and the other friends start a car wash to pay for a porcelain poodle that Bloo broke. To help, Bloo throws mud at every car that goes by to get more customers.

videos.title: Driving Miss Crazy
videos.overview: Frankie goes to a mechanic to find out about the bus, which had broken down, and everyone wants to come along, slowing her down.

videos.title: All Zapped Up
videos.overview: Frankie tells Bloo that static electricity can be produced by rubbing socks together. After learning this, he zaps Frankie, then Wilt, then both Wilt & Frankie at the same time. Running through the halls, he zaps Madame Foster, Coco and Jackie Khones. He tries to zap Mr. Herriman, but nothing happens. Bloo "re-charges" by rubbing onto the rug, a towel, an imaginary friend, and two socks. After that, he gives Eduardo a big zap. But in the end, Bloo zaps himself while trying to get the door open for his package.

videos.title: Bad to the Phone
videos.overview: Bloo tries to make a good recording message for the Fosters Home phone, getting various others to help. Eventually, Bloo gets satisfied with one but Madame Foster plugs too many devices into the same outlet as the phone, fricassing the phone from the overload.

videos.title: Truth or Stare
videos.overview: Mac and Bloo have a staring contest and Eduardo tries to talk to them only to think they're frozen solid, consequently getting Frankie to tell him about it. More of the house's residents watch in a bet, as Mac seems to start losing his grip, only to recover it. It is revealed that Bloo was hiding behind a cardboard cut-out of himself.

videos.title: Cranks a Lot
videos.overview: Bloo tricks Mac into making crank calls to Mr. Herriman. Their joke is simply blowing raspberries into the phone, redialing again and again. Each time Herriman tries to get back at them by doing the same thing, it isn't them redialing, it's Frankie asking about groceries in the mall. The last call Herriman gets wasn't from Mac and Bloo or Frankie. It was from Madame Foster.

videos.title: A Chore Thing
videos.overview: Mr. Herriman tells Bloo to sort the trash for punishment because Bloo hosted a mud-wrestling tournament in the living room. Mac comes along and talks Bloo into pretending it is fun so that other people will want to do it. Soon, he has everybody doing it. Mac tries to tell him that it isn't fun after Bloo refuses to go do something else. He thinks everybody is gonna take the trash for themselves and tells them to get out. Then he realizes it isn't fun without the guys and walks away, until Mr. Herriman comes in and tells him to finish sorting the trash.

videos.title: Hide and Bloo Seek
videos.overview: Bloo is determined to win a game of Hide and Seek, so he hides in the trash. Things go awry when a few friends start playing "Kick the Trashbag".

videos.title: Badvertisement
videos.overview: Bloo makes a commercial for Fosters and ends up in trouble when a bunch of people show up because he told them that the first people there in 10 minutes get money and the Fosters bus.

videos.title: Give Pizza a Chance
videos.overview: Bloo leaves the fridge open after getting himself a snack, which leads to Frankie telling Wilt to order pizza. Bloo tells him to order five hundred pizzas, at the price of $6532.12. Frankie can't pay that much, so Bloo, Wilt and Ed stall Quinn the delivery boy by sitting on him (because the pizza is free if it isn't there in 30 minutes).

videos.title: Drawing Bored
videos.overview: Eduardo tries to draw a story but Bloo, Wilt and Coco keep interrupting him, drawing their own additions to the story. Frankie interrupts them, revealing that they had been drawing on a wall in the house.

videos.title: Fistful of Cereal
videos.overview: Mr. Herriman and Bloo try to out-eat each other in order to claim the toy prize at the bottom of a cereal box.

videos.title: Petrified Pet
videos.overview: Bloo finds a strange rock digging in the yard and it is declared to be a fossil by Phineus B. Vurm, the bookworm imaginary friend. Bloo treats it as a pet until Frankie reveals it's actually petrified feces.

videos.title: Coconuts
videos.overview: Bloo tries to decipher a message from friends whose vocabulary has only one word each, like Coco. When he figures it out, he doesn't believe it until he realizes it is true.

videos.title: Pen Pal
videos.overview: Eduardo has a British penpal and Bloo is convinced that it's the Queen of England. He tries to make her his penpal instead by writing her a letter. Mac suggests to use Nancy, an English pen imaginary friend, but Bloo claims it'll make the letter "boring". Mac then suggests a care-package to make her really believe that Bloo cares. Bloo brings in a huge package, but it turns out the penpal was really Nancy. She claims the package is "boring" and she can only use it as a doorstop.

videos.title: Birthday Cake Bloos
videos.overview: It's Bloo's birthday, and his cake is being guarded by Mr. Herriman. After being refused to have his cake, Bloo leaves and Frankie comes in and sees Mr. Herriman sleeping on the job. She makes it look like he ate the cake in his sleep and leaves. Mr. Herriman soon wakes up and notices this and thinks he indeed ate the cake, at which point Frankie is yelling for Bloo to come into the kitchen, as they both enter, Frankie sees the cake is gone and scolds Bloo for it and threatens to kick him out. Feeling guilty, Mr. Herriman confesses that he ate the cake, on which both Frankie and Bloo begin to laugh, saying they pulled a prank on him and that the cake is just fine. When Frankie opens the refrigerator to show that the cake is fine, it actually is gone, having been taken by Madame Foster.

videos.title: Backpack Attack
videos.overview: Jackie Khones questions Bloo about Mac's backpack and Bloo becomes obsessed with finding out what's in it.

videos.title: Hair Today, Gone Tomorrow
videos.overview: Bloo ruins Mac's hair with gum the day before School Picture Day. Bloo tries to make it up to him but only makes matters worse.

videos.title: Nightmare on Wilson Way in 3D
videos.overview: Blooregard plans to play the ultimate trick on Halloween after tying down Mac onto a bed preventing another sugar rush, but when things go awry, most of the main characters of the residence turn into zombies in 3D!

videos.title: Exclusive Foster's Home For Imaginary Friends Promos
What Happens When Your Imagination Runs Wild
House of Bloo's (1)
videos.overview: Mac sends Bloo to live at Foster's Home for Imaginary Friends after being told by his mother that he is too old to have an imaginary friend. Once they meet various residents and get to know Wilt, Eduardo, Coco as well as the home's staff, the problem arises as they realise Bloo may get adopted if he moves in.

videos.title: House of Bloo's (2)
videos.overview: An evil imaginary friend sets a sinister plot in motion against Bloo, and Mac and the home's residents must save him.

videos.title: House of Bloo's (3)
videos.overview: Mac races to save Bloo from the sinister scheme of the evil imaginary friend.

videos.title: Busted
videos.overview: Mr. Herriman grows frustrated with Bloo's inability to follow the house rules and threatens to evict him. Under pressure, Bloo accidentally breaks a bust of Madame Foster and attempts to repair it before Mr. Herriman discovers the damage.

videos.title: Dinner is Swerved
videos.overview: When Mac visits Foster's, Bloo insists on showing him something on the roof, but the two become lost and cannot find their way back downstairs. Meanwhile, in the dining room, the others secretly sneak food while Mr. Herriman insists they wait for Bloo before starting dinner.

videos.title: Adoptcalypse Now
videos.overview: It's Adopt-A-Thought Saturday, an event that focuses on getting good friends adopted on the weekends when children are out of school. Mac and Bloo find out what Adopt-A-Thought Saturday is about after their good friend Jokey gets adopted and spend the day forcing the friends back into the house so that they won't be adopted.

videos.title: Store Wars
videos.overview: On Madame Foster's birthday, Frankie realizes she has forgotten to buy streamers for the party, prompting Mr. Herriman to send her to the store. Mac, Bloo, Eduardo, Wilt, and Coco accompany her but wander off in the mall and become involved in various mishaps, slowing Frankie down.

videos.title: Bloooo
videos.overview: Bloo and Mac play with each other in the mud while raining, which causes them to get sick. As Mac is taken home by Frankie, Bloo misses out on the scary movie the friends had planned to watch that night. When Wilt, Eduardo, and Coco begin to believe that the ghost in the movie is real, they mistake a pale Bloo to be the ghost. Meanwhile, Frankie gets locked out of the house in the rain after dropping off Mac and, as she tries to get back in, feels she's being stalked.

videos.title: The Trouble with Scribbles
videos.overview: Bloo decides to open the one door at the retirement home for imaginary friends that is never, ever to be opened, and the house becomes infested with something bad.

videos.title: Seeing Red
videos.overview: Terrence has an idea to make up a friend named Red to beat Bloo up with so he can bully Mac to his heart's content, though the friend he creates ends up friendly instead of mean and violent.

videos.title: Phone Home
videos.overview: Bloo is jealous of Wilt getting special attention for the number of abandoned imaginary friends he brings to Foster's, so he tries to rescue imaginary friends just like Wilt does. When Bloo finds a man in a cell-phone suit and thinks he's a friend, he takes him to Foster's, thinking everyone will give him more praise than they gave Wilt.

videos.title: World Wide Wabbit
videos.overview: Mac and Bloo get embarrassing footage of Mr. Herriman while conducting interviews for a Web site.

videos.title: Berry Scary
videos.overview: A new Imaginary Friend named Berry has her eyes on Bloo, and Mac stands between them.

videos.title: Who Let the Dogs In?
videos.overview: While taking out the trash, Eduardo finds a puppy and decides to keep it, despite dogs being forbidden in the house due to Mr. Herriman's fear of them.

videos.title: The Big Lablooski
videos.overview: Mac gets the gang to join a bowling team, but ends up getting booted off.

videos.title: Where There's a Wilt, There's a Way
videos.overview: All Wilt wants to do is watch a basketball game on TV, but the house's ridiculous requests and Wilt's inability to refuse to let them keep him from seeing the big game. This also reveals his dark secret: He can't say no to helping others unless he wants to have a panic attack.

videos.title: Everyone Knows It's Bendy
videos.overview: A new imaginary friend has come to Foster's, but he keeps misbehaving all around the house. All other imaginary friends are taking the blame, until Bloo comes up with his master plan.

videos.title: Partying is Such Sweet Soiree
videos.overview: Mac tries to thwart Bloo's plans for a party.

videos.title: Sight for Sore Eyes
videos.overview: A Seeing Eye Friend loses his blind kid, and the gang helps find him.

videos.title: Bloo's Brothers
videos.overview: Mac takes Bloo to school for show and tell. The kids love Bloo so much that they imagine their own variations on Bloo. Hundreds of Bloo clones are created, and Bloo dubs them his minions and himself leader. Mac plans on going to take Bloo to see The Ice Charades, but with hundreds of Bloos, he can't figure out which is the original.

videos.title: Cookie Dough
videos.overview: The home needs a new roof, so Bloo tries to fund it with a cookie drive.

videos.title: Frankie My Dear
videos.overview: Mac and Bloo fall for Frankie and become wildly jealous of each other and everyone else.

videos.title: Mac Daddy
videos.overview: When Mac accidentally imagines another friend, Bloo suffers sibling rivalry with the newly arrived and very odd Cheese.

videos.title: Squeakerboxxx
videos.overview: Bloo breaks a prize squeaking rubber elephant.

videos.title: Beat with a Schtick
videos.overview: Bloo is challenged to a fight at the end of the day, but he would rather avoid it.

videos.title: Sweet Stench of Success
videos.overview: Bloo becomes a celebrity as a deodorant mascot, but fame taints his relationship with Mac.

videos.title: Bye Bye Nerdy
videos.overview: Bloo tries to make Mac cool, and succeeds all to well.

videos.title: Bloo Done It
videos.overview: Bloo is suspicious of an old "Friend" of the house, Uncle Pockets, who returns after a long absence.

videos.title: My So-Called Wife
videos.overview: A case of mistaken identity sends Coco and Herriman to a high-society gala.

videos.title: Eddie Monster
videos.overview: Eduardo runs away from the Home to prove his bravery, but ends up over his head in a fight.

videos.title: Hiccy-Burp
videos.overview: Bloo gets a nasty case of the hiccups and must get rid of them before the big Imaginary Friend Pageant.

videos.title: Camp Keep a Good Mac Down
videos.overview: A camping trip becomes a problem when Bloo eats all the food.

videos.title: Duchess of Wails
videos.overview: The Duchess is adopted by Mac's neighbors, and the Foster's don't want to take her back.

videos.title: Imposter's Home for Um... Make 'Em Up Pals
videos.overview: A suspicious imaginary friend shows up at the house, and Frankie is out to prove him a fraud.

videos.title: Foster's Goes to Europe
videos.overview: Mac and the crew win a trip to Europe.

videos.title: Go Goo Go
videos.overview: The house is filling up with imaginary friends, thanks to a girl named Goo.

videos.title: Crime After Crime
videos.overview: Mr. Herriman tries to conceal his carrot addiction, which causes a lot of trouble at Foster's.

videos.title: Land of the Flea
videos.overview: Although Eduardo is infested with fleas, he soon befriends them, but Frankie and Mr. Herriman want to get rid of them.

videos.title: One False Movie
videos.overview: Mac and Bloo collaborate on a movie, which turns into a hit. Later, they must make an even better sequel for a film contest.

videos.title: Setting a President
videos.overview: Frankie faces a tough campaign against Mr. Herriman as they both compete to be president of Foster's.

videos.title: Room with a Feud
videos.overview: A single room opens up in the house, prompting Eduardo, Bloo and Coco to compete for it.

videos.title: Cuckoo for Coco Cards
videos.overview: Everyone becomes obsessed with card collection when Coco lays magical eggs filled with cards.

videos.title: A Lost Claus
videos.overview: Mac starts to doubt Santa's existence when a hoard of imaginary Santas appear. Bloo sets out to prove that he's real.

videos.title: Challenge of the Superfriends
videos.overview: When a large and dangerous imaginary friend is destroying the city, a superhero friend named Imaginary Man comes and saves the day, leaving Mac impressed. But once Mac becomes Imaginary Man's sidekick, Bloo becomes jealous and joins forces with Nemesis, Imaginary Man's mortal enemy and sister.

videos.title: The Big Picture
videos.overview: The residents prepare for the annual house photo. Meanwhile, Bloo, Mac and Goo search for an answer behind a weird photo of Foster's taken years ago, Eduardo gets an "extreme makeover" from Duchess, Coco realizes she needs to lose weight and Wilt has trouble being in the house photo without getting his head obscured.

videos.title: Squeeze the Day
videos.overview: When the home's residents go to the beach and leave Bloo in the house alone on purpose so that he doesn't ruin the fun, he and Mac try to squeeze in as much fun as possible and make it the best day of their lives.

videos.title: Neighbor Pains
videos.overview: Old Man Rivers, who lives across the street from Foster's, does not want imaginary friends on his lawn, and on "Adopt-A-Thought Saturday," his grandson, Young Man Rivers, makes faces at Bloo. Bloo and Madame Foster throw papers — that are adoption forms — at Old Man Rivers, who keeps them for himself, causing Bloo and Wilt to try to get them back. Meanwhile Eduardo tries to keep the parents busy so Bloo can get the adoption forms, but the parents get more impatient by the moment.

videos.title: Infernal Slumber
videos.overview: Bloo, Wilt, Eduardo, and eventually more guests arrive at Mac's apartment for a slumber party that Mac didn't plan. But because they are all so loud, Mac's mom or Terrence could wake up and get them all into trouble.

videos.title: I Only Have Surprise for You
videos.overview: Bloo, along with the rest of the house, plan a surprise party for Mac. However, Mac wants no part of it and tries to destroy their plans.

videos.title: Bus the Two of Us
videos.overview: Bloo notices after a trip to the grocery store that Frankie has left the keys in the bus, and decides to take Mac for a joyride in the Foster's bus, and Wilt, Coco and Goo promise to keep it a secret much to poor Wilt's disconcern.

videos.title: The Big Cheese
videos.overview: Foster's is going to be on TV, and Frankie wants everything perfect. Meanwhile, Cheese keeps showing up at Foster's, despite being told numerous times that he doesn't live there. In an attempt to keep him out, Mr. Herriman installs a security system. Unfortunately, due to his misreading of the directions, nobody knows the password except for Cheese, who memorized the code as a song. It is now up to the gang to get Cheese to recite it, and craziness ensues.

videos.title: Bloo's the Boss
videos.overview: Bloo alerts that an imaginary friend is in trouble. No one wants to help him at first because it might be a trick, but Madame Foster forces Frankie, Coco, Wilt, and Eduardo to help him. They find that the imaginary friend is stuck in a tree, and Bloo tries to help by climbing on top of them but only causes them to fall. Madame Foster manages to save the friend and is awarded for her good deed. Bloo tries to prove that he can also do good deeds and makes his own home for imaginary friends.

videos.title: Emancipation Complication
videos.overview: An imaginary pen, that resembles Abraham Lincoln, is caught with a student cheating on a test by Mac's teacher. He is saved from the classroom's closet by Mac and Bloo along with his au pair, a green ogre named Moose. The Lincoln pen cons Madame Foster into a new plan to adopt an overcrowded home to unsuspecting adopters for a fee, then takes over the house, planning to turn it into a casino.

videos.title: Good Wilt Hunting (1)
videos.overview: It's time for the 5 Year Creator Reunion Picnic, where imaginary friends' creators come to Foster's to see their imaginary friends. However, once again, Wilt's creator doesn't show up. Wilt, believing that his creator is still mad at him for a past let-down, sets off on a cross-country journey to find an imaginary friend that he lost to in a past basketball game and challenge him to another game to set things straight.

videos.title: Good Wilt Hunting (2)
videos.overview: Bloo and the gang are out to find Wilt and discover some interesting things about his secret past along the way.

videos.title: Make Believe it or Not
videos.overview: In her sleep, Goo accidentally creates all the villain characters from a make-believe game that she had helped out on while the power was out at the home during a thunderstorm, who then imprison Mac and Bloo at the home. Now, the gang must finish the game to save their friends.

videos.title: Cheese A Go-Go
videos.overview: Bloo is convinced that Cheese is an alien after watching a sci-fi movie about brain-eating spacemen and reading a tabloid newspaper with a picture that has an alien that resembles him and attempts to send a message to outer space.

videos.title: The Buck Swaps Here
videos.overview: The gang goes to a swap meet where a pick-pocketer is stealing money. He accidentally loses a $100 bill that Eduardo finds. Eduardo takes his money around the swap meet, looking for something to buy. But even the most sensible of the gang are tempted by the bill, and with the thief also trying to catch his bill, craziness ensues.

videos.title: Say It Isn't Sew
videos.overview: When the whole house goes to a fair, Mac and Bloo compete to see who will throw up last on a ride called the Vomit Comet. Bloo ditches Mac to ride in Madame Foster's Firebird, but a "quick" stop at the fabric store that is just across the street from the fair suddenly turns into a nightmare for Bloo that doesn't seem to end, causing him to take big measures to try to get out of it.

videos.title: Something Old, Something Bloo
videos.overview: Bloo visits a retirement home and inadvertently disguises himself as a senior, getting to live there and being pampered all day long. When Mac finds out about it, Madame Foster teams up with him in order to get Bloo out of there.

videos.title: The Bloo Superdude and the Magic Potato of Power
videos.overview: Bloo entertains Mac with an action-packed story about a crystal "potato" of power. A little boy (Eduardo), an alien (Coco), a hermit (Wilt), a magical fairy (Frankie), and the Superdude (Bloo) attempt to protect the crystal potato from the evil Lord Snooty (Mr. Herriman), who is taking away all the fun in the land ruled by the Queen (Madame Foster).

videos.title: Schlock Star
videos.overview: Bloo learns about a garage band known as Pizza Party. After realizing that he cannot be in the band, he starts his own musical act and inadvertently causes the creation of a concert.

videos.title: The Bride to Beat
videos.overview: Bloo is convinced Mac is going to be married, so he tries to act mature in order to impress Mac.

videos.title: Affair Weather Friends
videos.overview: A rich kid named Barry Bling comes to Foster's looking for a friend. He has a mansion filled with toys, which tempts Bloo so much that he starts cheating on Mac. But there's something strangely familiar about Barry...

videos.title: Nightmare on Wilson Way
videos.overview: Bloo tries the old peanut brittle can filled with snakes trick, thinking it as the ultimate Halloween prank after strapping Mac to his bed so as to not allow him to go trick-or-treating because of his sugar rushes. However, when Mr. Herriman tries his trick, Bloo thinks it has gone awry, and Mr. Herriman becomes a zombie, much to the shock of the other residents.

videos.title: Ticket to Rod
videos.overview: Bloo, Mac, Frankie and others are tangled up in a chaotic series of events when Frankie wins tickets to the premiere of a new action movie starring Rod Tango.

videos.title: Better Off Ed
videos.overview: Eduardo tells some little white lies to the nursery residents of Foster's, and now has to cover his tracks so they can't catch up to him.

videos.title: The Little Peas
videos.overview: This episode tells the story of "The Big Cheese" through the eyes of a pea-sized imaginary friend named Peas, detailing how he helped Frankie turn a negative into a positive.

videos.title: Let Your Hare Down
videos.overview: A plan to mellow out Mr. Herriman backfires when conditions at the house quickly deteriorate.

videos.title: Jackie Khones and the Case of the Overdue Library Crook
videos.overview: Mac discovers that an impostor has been checking out library books in his name and hires a detective to find the crook.

videos.title: Mondo Coco
videos.overview: Coco escapes from Foster's, and a chain of events has her on adventures all over the world.

videos.title: Pranks for Nothing
videos.overview: A termite infestation at Foster's forces Mr. Herriman to move the friends into a hotel for the night. While at the hotel, Bloo, being rambunctious, gets out of hand, disobeying all of Mr. Herriman's rules. To get rid of him, Wilt, Eduardo, and Coco play a prank on Bloo, though Mr. Herriman believes Bloo did it. Bloo, angry at Coco, challenges her to a prank war, turning the night into an outrageous chain of pranks.

videos.title: Bloo Tube
videos.overview: The friends have to make their own fun when rain forces them to cancel a trip to a water park. They decide to upload videos to ViewTube, while Bloo, sulking because of their cancelled trip, tries to ruin everyone's fun.

videos.title: Race for Your Life, Mac and Bloo
videos.overview: Bloo becomes tired of always losing to Mac at everything, so one day at the Prize Hive, he challenges Mac to a 30-mile race back to Foster's.

videos.title: Destination: Imagination (1)
videos.overview: Frankie is tired of working without being thanked. One day, a toy box is discovered at Foster's front door. Frankie is ordered to take it to the attic and leave it alone, but she knows there is an imaginary friend trapped inside, and opens the box to find it. When she looks inside, she falls into a strange imaginary world.

videos.title: Destination: Imagination (2)
videos.overview: After tackling certain bizarre toy box trials and tribulations, Bloo, Mac, Wilt, Eduardo, and Coco discover Frankie's whereabouts and set out to rescue her from the strange world.

videos.title: Destination: Imagination (3)
videos.overview: Frankie, Mac, Bloo, Mr. Herriman, Wilt, Eduardo and Coco must find a way to escape the mysterious realm of an imaginary friend.

videos.title: The Bloo Superdude and the Great Creator of Everything's Awesome Ceremony of Fun That He's Not Invited To
videos.overview: A deliriously ill Bloo attends Mac's birthday party and daydreams about his adventures as a superhero.

videos.title: Bad Dare Day
videos.overview: The friends have a house-wide dare competition that quickly gets out of hand.

videos.title: Read 'Em and Weep
videos.overview: Bloo is sad about Eduardo getting adopted and holds auditions to get an alternate one; meanwhile, the residents get letters from those that were adopted in the latest Adopt-a-Thought Saturday.

videos.title: Fools and Regulations
videos.overview: Frankie and Mr. Herriman host a party at Foster's and ask the friends to stay outside or upstairs.

videos.title: Goodbye to Bloo
videos.overview: When Mr. Herriman tells Bloo that Mac is moving, Bloo decides to give him the best day ever, though things do not go as he plans. All day, Mac does things with everyone but Bloo, making him angrier after every disappointment.

awards: Won 6 Primetime Emmys. 11 wins & 19 nominations total
